note: Nutrition values are taken from each chain's published US nutrition facts (standard build, no modifications), except chains marked "estimated": those don't publish nutrition, so values are estimates from comparable published items and USDA data, with the basis recorded per item in "basis". Prices are approximate US national averages and vary by location. Item format: [id, name, category, calories, protein_g, carbs_g, fat_g, sat_fat_g, fiber_g, sugar_g, sodium_mg, price_usd].

chains.name: McDonald's
tips: Order burgers with no mayo or sauce to cut 60-100 kcal.
Hamburger + 4 pc McNuggets is a 420 kcal, 21 g protein lunch.
Egg McMuffin is one of the best protein-per-calorie breakfasts in fast food.

chains.name: Burger King
tips: Whopper Jr. with no mayo is about 240 kcal.
Ask for no mayo on any Whopper to save ~160 kcal.
Chicken Fries are a decent protein snack at 280 kcal.

chains.name: Wendy's
tips: Small chili is 240 kcal with 16 g protein and 6 g fiber: one of the best value sides anywhere.
Grilled Chicken Sandwich is 350 kcal / 34 g protein.
Plain baked potato + small chili is a filling ~510 kcal meal.
items: Apple Pecan Chicken Salad (Full, with dressing)

chains.name: Taco Bell
tips: Order anything 'Fresco style' to swap cheese/sour cream for pico and save 50-100 kcal.
Chicken Soft Tacos are 160 kcal / 12 g protein each.
Power Menu Bowl with chicken is 470 kcal / 26 g protein / 8 g fiber.

chains.name: Chick-fil-A
tips: Grilled Nuggets (12 ct) are 200 kcal / 38 g protein: the best protein-per-calorie item in fast food.
Kale Crunch or Fruit Cup instead of fries saves 250+ kcal.
Grilled Cool Wrap has 12 g fiber.
items: Cobb Salad with Grilled Nuggets (no dressing)
Market Salad with Grilled Nuggets (no dressing)
Spicy Southwest Salad with Grilled Nuggets (no dressing)

chains.name: Chipotle
tips: Skip the tortilla (320 kcal) and go bowl or salad.
Double chicken adds 32 g protein for 180 kcal.
Guac is 230 kcal, sour cream 110, cheese 110, queso 120. Pick one.
Fajita veggies and fresh tomato salsa are nearly free calories.
items: Chicken Bowl (brown rice, black beans, fajita veg, tomato salsa, lettuce)
Chicken Bowl (white rice, pinto beans, corn salsa, cheese, sour cream, lettuce)

chains.name: Subway
tips: Any 6-inch on wheat with turkey or rotisserie chicken and all the veggies stays under 350 kcal.
Skip mayo/ranch; mustard, vinegar, and sweet onion sauce are 0-40 kcal.
Footlong = double everything, including sodium.

chains.name: Popeyes
tips: Blackened Tenders are 170 kcal / 26 g protein for 3 pieces: the leanest thing on the menu.
A leg + red beans & rice is under 400 kcal.
The Chicken Sandwich is 700 kcal; ask for no mayo to drop ~120.

chains.name: KFC
tips: Original Recipe drumstick is 130 kcal / 12 g protein.
Green beans (25 kcal) or mashed potatoes (130) beat fries (320).
Famous Bowl and Pot Pie are 720 kcal each and very high sodium.

chains.name: Arby's
tips: Classic Roast Beef is 360 kcal / 23 g protein.
Roast Turkey Farmhouse Salad without dressing is 230 kcal.
Curly fries are 410 kcal even in the small size.

chains.name: Sonic Drive-In
tips: Half-price drinks and slushes in the app, but a medium Cherry Limeade is still 210 kcal. Diet versions are ~15.
Jr. Burger is 310 kcal.
Corn dog is 230 kcal and a cheap snack.

chains.name: Jack in the Box
tips: Two tacos = 340 kcal, but 20 g fat and little protein.
Jr. Jumbo Jack is 340 kcal.
Chicken Teriyaki Bowl is low fat but 128 g carbs and 32 g sugar.

chains.name: Panera Bread
tips: Order any sandwich as a half with a cup of Ten Vegetable Soup for a ~500 kcal lunch.
Broccoli Cheddar is 240 kcal per cup, 370 per bowl.
Bagels start at 290 kcal before cream cheese.
items: Green Goddess Cobb Salad with Chicken (Whole)

chains.name: Five Guys
tips: 'Little' burgers are the single-patty size: Little Hamburger is 540 kcal.
Ask for a lettuce wrap to drop ~220 kcal of bun.
A 'Little' fries is 530 kcal; the regular is 950. Split one.

chains.name: In-N-Out Burger
tips: Protein Style (lettuce wrap) saves ~150 kcal on any burger.
Protein Style Hamburger is 240 kcal.
Fries are 370 kcal; Animal Style fries are 750.

chains.name: Culver's
tips: Grilled Chicken Sandwich is 350 kcal / 33 g protein.
Green beans or side salad instead of fries saves 340+ kcal.
Cheese curds are 690 kcal for a regular.

chains.name: Panda Express
tips: Super Greens instead of rice/chow mein saves 400+ kcal.
Grilled Teriyaki Chicken and String Bean Chicken are the leanest entrees.
Orange Chicken is 490 kcal per entree serving.

chains.name: Dunkin'
tips: Wake-Up Wraps are 190-240 kcal.
Black coffee or cold brew is ~5 kcal; a medium Frozen Coffee is 690.
A Boston Kreme is 300 kcal; a glazed is 240.

chains.name: Starbucks

tips: Each chicken finger is 130 kcal / 13 g protein; the sauce is 190 kcal by itself.
Skip the Texas Toast (150) and sauce (190) to trim a 3 Finger Combo by 340 kcal.
Coleslaw is the lighter side at 130 kcal vs 390 for fries.

chains.name: Whataburger
tips: Grilled Chicken Sandwich is 440 kcal / 33 g protein.
Whataburger Jr. is 310 kcal.

chains.name: Dairy Queen
tips: A mini Blizzard is 400 kcal vs 640 for a small.
The small vanilla cone (230 kcal) is the lightest treat.
The 4-pc Chicken Strip Basket is 1,180 kcal.

chains.name: Wingstop
tips: Classic bone-in wings are ~85 kcal each plain; dry rubs add little, wet sauces add 20-60 kcal each.
Ranch is 320 kcal per cup. Ask for it on the side or skip it.
Tenders (3 pc) are 350 kcal / 33 g protein.

chains.name: Chicken Express
chains.sourceNote: Chicken Express doesn't publish nutrition facts. These are estimates from comparable published items (Raising Cane's tenders, Popeyes bone-in chicken, KFC sides) and USDA data, so expect ±20%. The menu is Chicken Express's standard lineup and wasn't checked against your store's board. Prices vary by location.
tips: Tenders are the leanest fried protein here: 3 tenders are about 390 kcal and 39 g protein.
Green beans or corn instead of fries or fried okra saves roughly 200–300 kcal.
A medium sweet tea is about 200 kcal and 52 g sugar; unsweet is zero.

chains.name: Wings 'N More
chains.sourceNote: Wings 'N More doesn't publish nutrition facts. Items and portions come from wingsnmore.com; calories are estimates from comparable published items (Wingstop wings, Raising Cane's tenders, Arby's curly fries) and USDA data, so expect ±20%. Prices vary by location.
tips: Order wings dry with a seasoning like lemon pepper or garlic instead of wet sauce, and skip the bleu cheese: that saves about 300 kcal.
The Grilled Chicken Breast or Blackened Tilapia entrée is the lean pick: 510–830 kcal with 50–80 g protein.
Swap curly fries for grilled vegetables or a side salad to save about 330 kcal.

chains.name: Freebirds World Burrito
chains.sourceNote: Freebirds doesn't publish nutrition facts where MacroLane can reach them. Signature burritos and bowls are the sum of their listed ingredients (from freebirds.com's menu) at standard Freebird size; each ingredient is based on Chipotle's published value for the same ingredient or on USDA data, so expect ±20%. HalfBird, Monster and Super Monster sizes aren't listed. Prices vary by location.
tips: Go bowl on cauliflower rice instead of a tortilla and rice: that saves about 470 kcal.
The Keto and Paleo Burrito Bowls are about 475–575 kcal with steak and guac.
Queso, guac and sour cream are 110–230 kcal each. Pick one, and get creamy sauces on the side.
